AntigravityOptionsModel.description:
Wire DTO for Antigravity CLI launch options (see :class:`AntigravityOptions`).

``model`` is free-form ``str`` — like the Claude/Codex DTOs — carrying the
full display name ``agy models`` prints (e.g. ``Gemini 3.1 Pro (Low)``);
the launcher forwards it verbatim as a single argv element.
``skip_permissions`` (``--dangerously-skip-permissions``) and ``sandbox``
are mutually exclusive — skip-permissions auto-approves ``bypassSandbox``
actions, silently defeating the sandbox (google-antigravity/antigravity-cli
#36) — so the combination is rejected with a 422 at the wire boundary. To
keep that guard airtight, ``model`` and each ``add_dirs`` entry (both
forwarded verbatim as argv elements) are rejected when they look like a CLI
flag (leading ``-``): otherwise a value such as
``add_dirs=["--dangerously-skip-permissions"]`` could smuggle the blocked
flag past the pair check. No legitimate value is affected — model names
start with a letter and directories with ``/`` or a drive letter.
``protected_namespaces=()`` silences pydantic's ``model_*`` guard for the
legitimately-named ``model`` field.
AntigravityOptionsModel.title: AntigravityOptionsModel

AutoScanFilterModel.description:
Per-project Linear filter for Auto Scan Mode.

Mirrors :class:`mobaide.core.projects_config.AutoScanFilter`. Validation:

* ``state_names`` and ``label_names`` must each contain at least one
  non-empty string. An empty list would silently match every issue,
  which is almost certainly not what the user wants — better to fail
  loud at the API boundary.
* ``active_state``, ``done_state``, ``removal_label`` must be non-empty.
AutoScanFilterModel.title: AutoScanFilterModel

ClaudeOptionsModel.description:
Wire DTO for Claude CLI launch options (see :class:`ClaudeOptions`).

``effort`` is ``Literal``-typed so an invalid level is rejected with a 422 at
the wire boundary; ``model`` stays free-form (the client curates the alias
list). ``protected_namespaces=()`` silences pydantic's ``model_*`` guard for
the legitimately-named ``model`` field.
ClaudeOptionsModel.title: ClaudeOptionsModel

CodexLoginRequest.description:
API-key login payload.

The key is a :class:`pydantic.SecretStr` so it is auto-redacted in logs and
``repr``; it is piped to ``codex login --with-api-key`` via stdin and never
persisted by the agent (Codex writes its own ``auth.json``).
CodexLoginRequest.title: CodexLoginRequest

CodexOptionsModel.description:
Wire DTO for Codex CLI launch options (see :class:`CodexOptions`).

The enum-like fields are ``Literal``-typed so an invalid value is rejected
with a 422 at the wire boundary rather than producing a broken ``codex``
argv. ``protected_namespaces=()`` silences pydantic's ``model_*`` guard for
the legitimately-named ``model`` field.
CodexOptionsModel.title: CodexOptionsModel

GitDeleteItem.description:
One item in a delete request.

The wire shape mirrors :class:`GitItemRead`'s discriminator — clients
echo back the ``kind`` and the appropriate identifier (``branch`` for
branch kinds, ``worktree_path`` for worktree kinds; both for combined
deletions). ``force`` upgrades a branch delete from ``-d`` to ``-D`` and
adds ``--force`` to a worktree removal so a worktree holding
modified/untracked files is deleted instead of refused.
GitDeleteItem.title: GitDeleteItem

GitDeleteResultItem.description:
Per-item outcome.

``error`` codes:
    * ``force_required`` — branch is unmerged, or worktree holds
      modified/untracked files; retry with ``force=True``.
    * ``locked`` — worktree is locked.
    * ``not_found`` — branch or worktree no longer exists.
    * ``invalid`` — request payload missing the required identifier.
    * ``error`` — other git failure (full message in ``error_detail``).
GitDeleteResultItem.title: GitDeleteResultItem

GitItemRead.description:
One row in the unified git management list.

``branch`` is set for ``branch_*`` kinds; ``worktree_path`` is set for
``branch_with_worktree`` and ``orphan_worktree``. Status fields apply
where relevant; clients should ignore irrelevant fields.
GitItemRead.title: GitItemRead

LinearLabelModel.description: Linear label discovered via the per-project API key.
LinearLabelModel.title: LinearLabelModel

LinearStateModel.description:
Linear workflow state discovered via the per-project API key.

``type`` is one of Linear's documented state types (``backlog`` /
``unstarted`` / ``started`` / ``completed`` / ``canceled`` / ``triage``).
Empty when the schema didn't include it (defensive — should not happen).
LinearStateModel.title: LinearStateModel

ProjectReadModel.description: Client-safe view of a single project.
ProjectReadModel.title: ProjectReadModel

ProjectUpdateModel.description:
Request body for ``PUT /api/projects/{name}``.

Three-state semantics for ``linear_api_key`` and ``conda_env`` follow the
GitHub/Stripe convention:

* field omitted / ``null`` → keep the existing value,
* empty string → clear (store ``None``),
* non-empty string → replace.

For ``default_flags``: ``null``/omitted keeps, a dict replaces the whole
map. Use ``{}`` to clear all flags.

For ``auto_scan_filter``: ``null``/omitted keeps; a model replaces
wholesale (no field-level merge — the whole filter is one logical unit).
ProjectUpdateModel.title: ProjectUpdateModel

SessionResponse.description:
REST response for a single session.

Field set is the canonical wire shape — must stay in lockstep with
:func:`mobaide.core.models.session_to_wire_dict` and the Android
``SessionResponse`` DTO. Add or rename a field in one place only.
SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse

post.description:
Trigger the staged-binary updater immediately, bypassing idle deferral.

Returns the updater outcome string verbatim (``"staged"``,
``"signature_failed"``, ``"no_change"``, ``"deferred"``) so the client
can surface a meaningful toast. On ``"staged"`` the supervisor restart
is scheduled as a FastAPI background task that runs *after* the HTTP
response is flushed, so the client receives the 200 reliably before
the worker exits with code ``EXIT_RESTART_REQUESTED``.

schema.title: Response Force Update Now Api Agent Update Force Now Post

post.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a new token pair (rotation).
Validate credentials and return JWT access + refresh tokens.

Trigger an immediate scan cycle for a running auto scan.

Returns the freshly anchored ``next_scan_at`` so the caller can
rebind its countdown synchronously, without waiting for the bus event.
Start an auto scan for a project. 409 if already running, 429 if at cap.

schema.title: Response Start Scan Api Autoscan Start Post
Response Stop Scan Api Autoscan Stop Post

post.description:
Authenticate the host's Codex CLI with an OpenAI API key.

Runs ``codex login --with-api-key`` as a one-shot subprocess with the key on
stdin (never argv, never persisted by us). The same configured binary and
``CODEX_HOME`` the launcher uses are applied, so the credential lands where
the create-session auth guard reads it.

schema.title: Response List Projects Endpoint Api Projects Get

post.description: Create a new project. Returns 409 if the name is already taken.

patch.description: Atomically replace project ordering. 400 on set mismatch.

schema.title: Response Reorder Projects Endpoint Api Projects Order Patch

delete.description: Remove a project. 404 if unknown, 409 if a scan is active for it.

put.description:
Update a project. Supports rename via ``body.name``.

* 404 if ``name`` is unknown.
* 409 if renaming while an auto-scan is active for the old name, or if
  the new name collides with another existing project.

get.description: Return the unified list of local branches and worktrees.

post.description:
Delete one or more branches/worktrees in a single batch.

Returns 409 with ``{busy_by: [...]}`` if any worktree in the batch is
held by a running session or auto-scan work item; the client should
surface a busy-conflict dialog and refuse to retry until the user
stops the holder. Per-item git failures (unmerged branch, locked
worktree, etc.) are returned in the 200 body so the user can act on
each row independently.

get.description:
Return labels visible to the project's Linear API key, deduped by name.

Used by the Android project form to populate the multi-select chip
group for trigger labels and the dropdown for the removal label.

* 404 if the project is unknown.
* 400 if the project has no Linear API key.
* 502 if the upstream Linear API call fails.

schema.title: Response List Linear Labels Api Projects  Name  Linear Labels Get

get.description:
Return workflow states visible to the project's Linear API key.

Used by the Android project form to populate the multi-select chip
group for trigger states and the dropdowns for active / done states.

* 404 if the project is unknown.
* 400 if the project has no Linear API key.
* 502 if the upstream Linear API call fails.

schema.title: Response List Linear States Api Projects  Name  Linear States Get
Response List Sessions Api Sessions Get

get.description: Return the scrollback buffer for a session (for reconnection).

schema.title: Response Version Info Api Version Get
